profile_text: As a leading auction house, this company specializes in the sale of art, antiques, and collectibles, catering to a niche market with unique and high-value items. With a growth rate of 47.1% since the baseline, its success can be attributed to its expertise in curating rare and valuable pieces, attracting a loyal client base of collectors and connoisseurs. This Scaler company has expanded its team to 25 employees in 2024, solidifying its position in the administrative and support service activities sector.
